facts.fact: Simone 每夜看着父亲打母亲，梦里一艘帆船起锚、海盗帮成形——这是他要上报的征兆，他飞走去报信。
facts.anchor: It’s being dreamed by a boy whose name in Flesh is Simone, who nightly watches his father beat his mother.

facts.fact: Aminata（家里第一个在罗马出生的人）走在空荡的 Monti，进酒馆给自己打了一杯 Guinness，听见有人说「Thank you」，抬头看见令她又惊奇又恐惧的东西。
facts.anchor: And most of all she’d like to escape the thing that’s watching her; she can’t see it, but she knows it’s there.

facts.fact: Fatty（Stranieri 教授）把 DuQuette 的发现贬成「孩子梦见海盗美人鱼有什么稀奇」，并给 Giovanni 两个选项：七月交哈欠论文，或十月交岛。
facts.anchor: So, there are two options: yawning in July, or your Island in October.

facts.fact: Giovanni 从起床起就有说不清的 unease；与妹妹 Angela 吃披萨，她讲帽子里凭空出现的兔子；他举 De Martino、Elkin 为例，说鬼魂目击已大幅崩塌。
facts.anchor: Giovanni finds the name for what he’s feeling: unease.

facts.fact: Wendy 用海边的「回抽」打比方：水退得像消失，然后大浪会来——也许魔法正在回抽，浪要来了。
facts.anchor: Maybe there’s been a backwash. Maybe the swell is coming.

facts.fact: Michele 逃学去 EUR 看涂鸦：一幅署名 Nibs 的画——傻气的小岛、戴礼帽的裸女、飞在半空的人、远处驶来的小船；他拍照、买漫画，并接到 Greta 电话约五点来家里。
facts.anchor: It showed a goofy little island topped with a grinning figure.

facts.fact: 拳馆里 Guido 教练训 Giovanni 太谨慎；Giovanni 十岁起练拳（因在校外把欺负他的人往沥青上砸），父亲送他去的，并说「永远别挡在自然与它的循环之间」。
facts.anchor: “Never get between nature and its cycles,” Papa continued, “or you’ll be crushed.”

facts.fact: Greta 来家里看漫画大纲；饭桌上父亲呕吐，Greta 借故离开；Michele 清理时在呕吐物里发现一颗桃核。
Dal Mare 已经剖开两个孩子读内脏，还需要第三个才能得到他要的答案。
facts.anchor: Augusto Dal Mare has opened up two of them, but he needs the third to obtain the answers he seeks.

facts.fact: Wendy 主持周五吸血鬼跑团；散场后 Giada 说罗马的怪事越来越多、街道在变，约她明天午饭看一个从没对人说过的秘密。
facts.anchor: I don’t know what is in Rome, but something is. The streets are changing.

facts.fact: Giovanni 回家想靠 Luisa 驱散 unease，可一被抱住就明白哪里不对：Luisa 的眼睛变了颜色。

relations.anchor: When they were both teenagers, Angela looked out for her brother, two years her junior.

relations.note: Giada 是 Wendy 跑团里的玩家兼好友，做一份「见惯怪事」的工作。
relations.anchor: In my work I see a lot of weird things, Angela—I have since day one.

relations.note: Greta 被 Michele 叫作 Mary Jane（蜘蛛侠妻子的名字）。
relations.anchor: Spider-Man is his and Greta’s favourite superhero, and Mary Jane is the web-crawler’s wife. That’s why Michele calls her that.
